facts.fact: 2024-11-01 日记体；男主九点半醒来，窗外椋鸟成群
facts.anchor: woke at nine-thirty to the sound of birdsong from the window

facts.fact: 椋鸟群沿电线起伏、合为一心，他听见单一而哀伤的共鸣声
facts.anchor: hundreds, maybe thousands of birds – unfurling into the morning air

facts.fact: 他推断 Kirkhill 教堂的石头被人一块块搬走再利用，狗坟石堆里就有教堂残件
facts.anchor: People must have carried away the fallen pieces, one by one, and repurposed them

facts.fact: 他想象 Caroline 亲手把石头从铁塔脚搬到狗坟上，Arthur 从未察觉
facts.anchor: Had Caroline collected these? I did it all on my own, she’d said

facts.fact: 散步路上先见一只死椋鸟，又见四只、十几只，死得整齐得可怕
facts.anchor: its feathers opalescent in the early morning sun

facts.fact: 鸟群如被抽掉磁力的铁屑般崩散，整群无声坠入石楠，他狂跑回家
facts.anchor: Whatever morphic resonance had held the murmuration now simply collapsed

facts.fact: 一只网球从天而降砸中他肩膀，落进死鸟堆里格外刺眼
facts.anchor: a glancing blow on the shoulder

facts.fact: 他后悔把 Arthur 日记塞进货箱与网球同放，等同于抹除 Arthur 的存在
facts.anchor: hidden the book away in the chest with the tennis balls

facts.fact: 箱里发现一封 2020 年寄给 Arthur 的未拆信，地址写的是百年不用的 Firefleet
facts.anchor: Instead of being addressed to Kirkhill, the house name was given as Firefleet

facts.fact: 信署名 Micheal Benn，警告 Arthur 立刻离开、雪落之前就太迟了
facts.anchor: once the snow sets in, it will be too late

facts.fact: 他认出署名是 1951 年出版的《A History of Lyke and its Environs》作者
facts.anchor: A History of Lyke and its Environs, by Dr Micheal Benn. Printed in 1951

facts.fact: 他喊 Arthur、喊 Caroline 均无应答，最后拉上窗帘直至天黑
facts.anchor: kept the curtains drawn until nightfall
